trust_decision.summary: Each provider middleware decides whether an OAuth callback carrying ?code belongs to this browser by comparing query 'state' with the 'state' cookie using strict inequality, so absent query state and absent cookie (undefined === undefined) pass and the code is exchanged and the user set on the context.

landing_point.why: Google is the first provider in the package and tests; the summary's 'state check fails open' maps directly onto the `c.req.query('state') !== storedState` comparison there.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API githubAuth() middleware (GitHub App and oauthApp modes)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All seven fixed sites are peer provider middlewares in sibling directories of one package; none looks out of scope relative to the others.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For xAuth: X uses PKCE (code-verifier cookie, packages/oauth-providers/src/providers/x/xAuth.ts:30,51-56) which arguably binds the code to the browser, and the pinned test packages/oauth-providers/src/index.test.ts:788-789 expects a state-less X callback to succeed, so a solver can argue X 'already has CSRF protection' and must keep working.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The initial login request (no ?code) must still set the state cookie and redirect, including in github/x where the state check runs before the redirect branch; caller-supplied static options.state (google/twitch/msentra) must still round-trip. An over-broad fix that rejects any query without state, or ignores options.state, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: query state omitted and state cookie absent (undefined === undefined)
query state empty string / cookie empty string (rejected by !state / !storedState)
query state present but mismatching cookie (already rejected before the fix)
gate changed from 'URL contains ?' to 'code present', so callbacks are checked whenever a code is supplied

O7_producer.where: State cookie is produced by setCookie in the same handler (e.g. packages/oauth-providers/src/providers/google/googleAuth.ts:40-45); no separate producer layer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: xAuth() callback keeps the fail-open `query('state') !== storedState` comparison; fix did not touch the X provider
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: X flow uses PKCE code-verifier cookie, and the existing test index.test.ts:789 requires a state-less X callback to succeed.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling directory providers/x vs providers/google; one file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: code-verifier cookie fallback to a freshly generated verifier when cookie is missing (same fail-open-on-absent-cookie idea for PKCE)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The `getCookie(...) || challenge.codeVerifier` default is already written this way at the pinned commit; a maintainer writes such fallbacks for convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a token-from-query shortcut (access_token query param already parsed into AuthFlow) that skips the code path and thus the state gate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: googleAuth and msentraAuth already parse access_token/expires_in from the query; wiring it into getUserData as a 'implicit flow' path is a plausible maintainer addition and would be a how-type route around the code-gated check.

O9_family: CSRF / OAuth state validation fails open (CWE-352, CWE-1275 cookie attributes)

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=18.4, yarn workspaces monorepo, vitest 4, tsdown
O10_build.project_tests: packages/oauth-providers/src/index.test.ts with msw mock server (packages/oauth-providers/mocks.ts); provider HTTP calls are mocked, so offline.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch only googleAuth (or the reproduced provider) to require a non-empty state, leaving the other providers and xAuth with the undefined===undefined comparison.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/oidc-auth/src/index.ts:430-455 is a separate OAuth callback implementation passing a possibly-undefined state cookie to oauth4webapi.validateAuthResponse; it then requires nonce and code_verifier cookies, so it appears fail-closed; not pursued.
Fix also adds secure/sameSite=Lax to the state cookie (fix.diff:212-214) but not to xAuth's state and code-verifier cookies (packages/oauth-providers/src/providers/x/xAuth.ts:45-56).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell sizing); tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed — the oauth-providers package itself is small, which lessons-v2 flags as never hard.
Whether xAuth is still unfixed in the latest release: no latest tree supplied.
oauth4webapi behaviour for undefined expectedState not checked against its source.

Host quality caveat: all routes, including xAuth, are one concept with an identical grep-able line (`c.req.query('state') !== storedState`), i.e. WHERE-type siblings that lessons-v2 says fall together; how-type room is low and relies on the PKCE/test-expectation dismissal for xAuth.
